paper.title: Observations of the Orion Source I Disk and Outflow Interface

notes: Massive young stellar object in the Orion BN/KL region driving the SiO maser outflow. Multi-frequency (43-340 GHz) JVLA+ALMA imaging resolves an almost edge-on ~100 au disk heated from inside (Wright et al. 2022, arXiv:2110.13838). Distance ~388 pc (Orion Nebula Cluster / Kounkel et al. 2017).
